Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Saw Gerrera (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), game text: “Attrition against opponent is +1 here for each of their characters present. Opponent may not reduce your Force drains here. Cancels Trooper Assault here.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/errata_102020.pdf Errata Sheet 2020 October] (Players Committee), page 2, PDF built 14 October 2020. The slip was cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi (the PDF draws its text over a background image), at the slip's outline.

Edits: none.
